segments.text: Diagram design is a clawed code skill built by someone tired of fighting Figma for 30 minutes every time she needed an architecture sketch. Your agent becomes
a high-end editorial graphic designer generating stunning self-contained HTML and SVG files. Zero JavaScript, zero
external images, zero build steps. 13 built-in structural types, including sequence diagrams, state machines, vend diagrams, and swim lanes.
